A breach of one or both of the said conditions of stay will render the Helper and/or any aider and abettor liable to criminal prosecution.
strings.key_employer_pay_helper_wages: 5. (a) The Employer shall pay the Helper wages of HK$
strings.key_minimum_allowable_wage_required: per month. The amount of wages shall not be less than the minimum allowable wage announced by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and prevailing at the date of this contract. An employer who fails to pay the wages due under this employment contract shall be liable to criminal prosecution.
strings.key_employer_provide_suitable_accommodat: (b) The Employer shall provide the Helper with suitable and furnished accommodation as per the attached Schedule of Accommodation and Domestic Duties and food free of charge. If no food is provided, a food allowance of HK$
strings.key_food_allowance_if_no_food_provided: a month shall be paid to the Helper.
strings.key_employer_provide_receipt_for_payment: (c) The Employer shall provide a receipt for payment of wages and food allowance and the Helper shall acknowledge receipt of the amount under his/her* signature.
strings.key_helper_entitled_to_rest_days_holiday: 6. The Helper shall be entitled to all rest days, statutory holidays, and paid annual leave as specified in the Employment Ordinance, Chapter 57.
strings.key_employer_provide_free_passage: 7. (a) The Employer shall provide the Helper with free passage from his/her* place of origin to Hong Kong and on termination or expiry of this contract, free return passage to his/her* place of origin.
strings.key_daily_food_travel_allowance_100_hkd: (b) A daily food and travelling allowance of HK$100 per day shall be paid to the Helper from the date of his/her* departure from his/her* place of origin until the date of his/her* arrival at Hong Kong if the travelling is by the most direct route. The same payment shall be made when the Helper returns to his/her* place of origin upon expiry or termination of this contract.
strings.key_employer_responsible_for_fees_expens: 8. The Employer shall be responsible for the following fees and expenses (if any) for the departure of the Helper from his/her place of origin and entry into Hong Kong:—
strings.key_authentication_fees_consulate: (ii) authentication fees by the relevant Consulate;
strings.key_administration_fee: (v) administration fee or fee such as the Philippines Overseas Employment Administration fee, or other fees of similar nature imposed by the relevant government authorities; and
strings.key_employer_reimburse_helper_costs: In the event that the Helper has paid the above costs or fees, the Employer shall fully reimburse the Helper forthwith the amount so paid by the Helper upon demand and production of the corresponding receipts or documentary evidence of payment.
strings.key_employer_provide_free_medical_treatm: 9. (a) In the event that the Helper is ill or suffers personal injury during the period of employment specified in Clause 2, except for the period during which the Helper leaves Hong Kong of his/her* own volition and for his/her* own personal purposes, the Employer shall provide free medical treatment to the Helper. Free medical treatment includes medical consultation, maintenance in hospital and emergency dental treatment. The Helper shall accept medical treatment provided by any registered medical practitioner.
strings.key_helper_accept_medical_treatment: (b) If the Helper suffers injury by accident or occupational disease arising out of and in the course of employment, the Employer shall make payment of compensation in accordance with the Employees' Compensation Ordinance, Chapter 282.
strings.key_employer_compensation_for_injury: (c) In the event of a medical practitioner certifying that the Helper is unfit for further service, the Employer may subject to the statutory provisions of the relevant Ordinances terminate the employment and shall immediately take steps to repatriate the Helper to his/her* place of origin in accordance with Clause 7.
strings.key_termination_with_one_month_notice: 10. Either party may terminate this contract by giving one month's notice in writing or one month's wages in lieu of notice.
strings.key_termination_without_notice_permitted: 11. Notwithstanding Clause 10, either party may in writing terminate this contract without notice or payment in lieu in the circumstances permitted by the Employment Ordinance, Chapter 57.
strings.key_notice_to_director_of_immigration: 12. In the event of termination of this contract, both the Employer and the Helper shall give the Director of Immigration notice in writing within seven days of the date of termination. A copy of the other party's written acknowledgement of the termination shall also be forwarded to the Director of Immigration.
strings.key_helper_return_to_place_of_origin: 13. Should both parties agree to enter into new contract upon expiry of the existing contract, the Helper shall, before any such further period commences and at the expense of the Employer, return to his/her* place of origin for a paid/unpaid* vacation of not less than seven days, unless prior approval for extension of stay in Hong Kong is given by the Director of Immigration.
strings.key_employer_pay_transport_costs_on_deat: 14. In the event of the death of the Helper, the Employer shall pay the cost of transporting the Helper's remains and personal property from Hong Kong to his/her* place of origin.
strings.key_variations_void_without_consultation: 15. Save for the following variations, any variation or addition to the terms of this contract (including the annexed Schedule of Accommodation and Domestic Duties) during its duration shall be void unless made with the prior consent of the Commissioner for Labour:
strings.key_variation_period_of_employment_exten: (a) a variation of the period of employment stated in Clause 2 through an extension of the said period of not more than one month by mutual agreement and with prior approval obtained from the Director of Immigration;
strings.key_variation_employers_residential_addr: (b) a variation of the Employer's residential address stated in Clause 3 upon notification in writing being given to the Director of Immigration, provided that the Helper shall continue to work and reside in the Employer's new residential address;
strings.key_variation_schedule_of_accommodation: (c) a variation in the Schedule of Accommodation and Domestic Duties made in such manner as prescribed under item 7 of the Schedule of Accommodation and Domestic Duties; and
strings.key_variation_driving_duties: (d) a variation of item 4 of the Schedule of Accommodation and Domestic Duties in respect of driving of a motor vehicle, whether or not the vehicle belongs to the Employer, by the Helper by mutual agreement in the form of an Addendum to the Schedule and with permission in writing given by the Director of Immigration for the Helper to perform the driving duties.
strings.key_above_terms_do_not_preclude_the_help: 16. The above terms do not preclude the Helper from other entitlements under the Employment Ordinance, Chapter 57, the Employees' Compensation Ordinance, Chapter 282 and any other relevant Ordinances.
strings.key_helper_medically_examined_fit_for_em: 17. The Parties hereby declare that the Helper has been medically examined as to his/her fitness for employment as a domestic helper and his/her medical certificate has been produced for inspection by the Employer.

strings.key_privacy_page_meta_description: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information on MaidMatch.
strings.key_privacy_policy_intro_part2: ) values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application (
strings.key_privacy_policy_intro_part4: ). By using MaidMatch, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
strings.key_privacy_section_1_intro: We collect personal information to provide and improve our services. This includes:
strings.key_privacy_section_1_1_item1: Name, email address, phone number, and date of birth.
strings.key_privacy_section_1_1_item2: Employment details (e.g., job preferences, skills, work experience).
strings.key_privacy_section_1_1_item3: Profile details such as nationality, languages spoken, photos, and references.
strings.key_privacy_section_1_2_item1: Device and usage data, such as IP address, browser type, operating system, and app interactions.
strings.key_privacy_section_1_2_item2: Geolocation data when you use location-based features or grant location access.
strings.key_privacy_section_1_2_item3: Cookies and similar technologies to track activity on our Platform.
strings.key_privacy_section_1_3_item1: Data from social media accounts (e.g., Facebook, Google) when used for registration.
strings.key_privacy_section_1_3_item2: Verification data from Partner Agencies or third-party services.
strings.key_privacy_section_2_intro: We use your information for the following purposes:
strings.key_privacy_section_2_item1: To provide and manage our services, including job matching and interview scheduling.
strings.key_privacy_section_2_item2: To facilitate communication between Employers, Workers, and Partner Agencies.
strings.key_privacy_section_2_item3: To verify your identity and ensure compliance with legal requirements.
strings.key_privacy_section_2_item4: To send notifications and updates related to your account and activities.
strings.key_privacy_section_2_item5: To analyze usage patterns and improve our Platform's functionality.
strings.key_privacy_section_2_item6: To protect against fraud, unauthorized access, or illegal activities.
strings.key_privacy_section_3_intro: We may share your personal information under the following circumstances:
strings.key_privacy_section_3_1_item1: Worker profiles, including name, work experience, and references, are shared with Employers and Partner Agencies to facilitate job matching, interview scheduling, and contract processing.
strings.key_privacy_section_3_1_item2: Employer job details are shared with Workers and Partner Agencies as part of the placement process.
strings.key_privacy_section_3_1_item3: Partner Agency details, including names and license numbers, are shared during interview scheduling.
strings.key_privacy_section_3_2_item1: Third-party vendors for analytics, marketing, and customer support.
strings.key_privacy_section_3_3_item1: When required by law or legal process, such as subpoenas or court orders.
strings.key_privacy_section_3_3_item2: To protect our rights, users, and Platform from fraud or illegal activity.
strings.key_privacy_section_3_4_item1: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of our assets, your information may be transferred to the new entity.
strings.key_privacy_section_4_intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:
strings.key_privacy_section_4_1_item1: Request access to the personal data we hold about you.
strings.key_privacy_section_4_1_item2: Request corrections to inaccurate or incomplete data.
strings.key_privacy_section_4_2_item1: Request a copy of your data in a portable format.
strings.key_privacy_section_4_3_item1: Request deletion of your personal information, subject to legal retention requirements.
strings.key_privacy_section_4_4_item1: Opt-out of marketing communications at any time.
strings.key_privacy_section_4_4_item2: Restrict the processing of your personal data for certain purposes.
strings.key_privacy_section_4_5_item1: You will not be discriminated against for exercising your privacy rights.
strings.key_privacy_section_4_contact_text: To exercise these rights, contact us at
strings.key_privacy_section_5_intro: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to:
strings.key_privacy_section_5_item1: Fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy.
strings.key_privacy_section_5_item2: Comply with legal and regulatory requirements.
strings.key_privacy_section_5_item3: Resolve disputes and enforce our terms.
strings.key_privacy_section_5_conclusion: When no longer needed, your data will be securely deleted or anonymized.
strings.key_privacy_section_6_intro: We implement robust security measures to protect your personal information, including:
strings.key_privacy_section_6_item1: Encryption for data in transit and at rest.
strings.key_privacy_section_6_item3: Regular monitoring for vulnerabilities and breaches.
strings.key_privacy_section_6_conclusion: Despite these efforts, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure.
strings.key_privacy_section_7_intro: We use cookies and similar technologies to:
strings.key_privacy_section_7_item2: Track and analyze usage patterns on our Platform.
strings.key_privacy_section_7_conclusion: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.
strings.key_privacy_section_8_text: Your information may be transferred to and stored in countries outside your own, including jurisdictions that may not provide the same level of data protection. We ensure such transfers comply with applicable legal requirements.
strings.key_privacy_section_9_text: MaidMatch is not intended for use by individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
strings.key_privacy_section_10_text: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. Updates will be posted on this page with the "Effective Date" updated. Continued use of the Platform constitutes acceptance of the revised Privacy Policy.
strings.key_privacy_section_11_intro: For questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us at:

strings.key_bulk_cs_assistant_note: Only active staff who already hold the necessary Branch access and permissions appear here — a formally titled CS Assistant or another CS acting in that capacity. Unassigned is a valid destination. The record’s CS Owner can never be its CS Assistant. Assignment grants nothing and never changes the CS Owner, Branch, invoices or Insurance ownership.
strings.key_bulk_cs_owner_note: Only active staff with Manual ticked under Ownership Assignment (CS), with access to each record’s CURRENT Branch, can receive it. The record’s Branch is preserved (an explicit Branch change is a separate audited operation); linked invoice ownership follows the new owner. A recipient who is a record’s CS Assistant requires the assistant to be removed or replaced first.

strings.key_reassign_cs_owner_note: Only active staff with Manual ticked under Ownership Assignment (CS), with access to this record’s Branch, appear here. The record’s Branch is preserved (an explicit Branch change is a separate audited operation); linked invoice ownership follows the new owner. A recipient who is this record’s CS Assistant requires the assistant to be removed or replaced first.
strings.key_reassign_cs_assistant_note: Only active staff who already hold the necessary Branch access and permissions appear here — a formally titled CS Assistant or another CS acting in that capacity. The record’s CS Owner cannot be its CS Assistant. Assignment grants no access, permissions or commission and never changes the CS Owner, Branch, invoices or Insurance ownership. Unassigned is a valid choice.
